title: Component Storage Drawer Cabinet (Akro-Mils style) — What the drawer cabinet is
description: The Akro-Mils-style drawer cabinet is the bench's small-parts library: a steel frame holding 64 polypropylene drawers for screws, standoffs, jumpers, and adapters. The 10164 is the iconic 64-drawer model every workshop seems to own.
